description: A follow-up on the car on screen after a first answer

turns.message: What would this one cost me all in, and how soon can I get it? Also, what do owners say?

events.text: Getting the quote and owner reviews…

The estimated total is $39,427: the $35,590 price plus $3,837 in estimated taxes and fees. Delivery to 94402 can be as soon as Saturday. If you finance, a GAP waiver is available for $1,195.

Owners mostly like it: 1,221 of 1,518 ratings are 4 or 5 stars. Reviewers praise the comfort, safety features and technology, and low running costs if you can charge at home. The complaints: cruise control and autosteer braking for no reason, uneven heating and cooling, wind noise above 45 mph, and long waits for Tesla service.

sections.name: reviews
sections.summary: 1,221 of 1,518 owner ratings are 4 or 5 stars.

lines.text: I was hesitant about owning an EV and especially Tesla since I have heard stories about quality issues. However, my Tesla has been amazing and it's one of the best purchases I have made in the car realm.  Extremely comfortable to drive, amazing safety features. Constant over the air updates. Solid warranty on power train and battery.
Don't listen to the haters. The Tesla Model Y is safe, reliable, and has all the tech you want but simplified in an easy to understand interface.
I use this car to drive rideshare (my retirement job). I drive most of the day 5 days a week everyone loves my car, including me. Completely problem free.
Love it, don't miss pumping gas, love how quickly it accelerates.

Don't buy it. AC or heating system is a failure. Air doesn't distribute uniformly. No phone mirroring; Difficult to control using small font screen. Service is aweful; You won't get an appointment in the next 2 months. Navigation system doesn't always find the superchargers;

components.text: Estimated total adds Carvana's estimated taxes and fees to the price. Final amounts are set at checkout.

turns.message: And the GAP waiver, how much was it again?

events.text: The GAP waiver for this car is $1,195. The quote didn't include it in the estimated total of $39,427. I can't tell you what it covers beyond that, so check the car's page for the terms.
